title: Add independent editable User and Agent chat avatars
goal: Allow the user to select, persist, preview, replace, and reset a separate Agent avatar while retaining the existing user profile avatar as the single source for user messages.
context: Follow-up to PAUI-003. User explicitly asked to edit both Agent and User photos because the UI changes felt too small. Keep the changes presentation-only and preserve the UI V2 opt-in flag.
forbidden_changes: Do not alter Agent Runtime, policies, permissions, provider routing, workspace execution, or conversation persistence.
Do not reuse profile.avatar.data for the Agent; profile.agentAvatar.data is a separate local setting.
Do not decode image bytes for every message render or streaming token update.
Do not remove UI V2 opt-in or change the V1 default.
acceptance_criteria: Profile allows choosing a User avatar and a separate Agent avatar.
Agent avatar can be replaced and reset to the themed fallback.
User messages display profile.avatar.data and Agent replies, including streaming replies, display profile.agentAvatar.data.
Avatar changes refresh without restarting the app and persist locally.
Images are resized/compressed before persistence and missing images use accessible fallbacks.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA are checked on the exact PR head.
Physical-device visual behavior is reported separately from CI.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA on the exact PR head.
recovery: Revert the Agent avatar state and rendering independently if a regression appears; preserve the existing User profile avatar and UI V2 toggle.
